description: Holds the latest dynamic snapshot of tools advertised by an MCP connector for a given gateway.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

connectorHash.description: The hash of the resolved connector at the time of the snapshot. Used to distinguish upstream drift from connector configuration changes.
connectorHash.title: connectorHash

connectorName.description: The Name of the MCP connector this snapshot describes.
connectorName.title: connectorName

diagnostic.description: A diagnostic explaining the drift outcome.
diagnostic.title: diagnostic

drifted.description: Whether the live tools list diverges from the baseline.
drifted.title: drifted

extraction.description: The analyzer findings from running the drifted tool list through the analyzers. Populated only when the snapshot is in a drifted state.
extraction.title: extraction

firstDriftedAt.description: When divergence was first observed. Set on entering drift, cleared on leaving it.
firstDriftedAt.title: firstDriftedAt

gatewayName.description: The Name of the AI gateway this snapshot belongs to.
gatewayName.title: gatewayName

lastFetchedAt.description: When the last successful upstream fetch occurred.
lastFetchedAt.title: lastFetchedAt

mcpServer.description: The Name of the MCP server backing this connector, used to scope access policies when resolving MCP attack findings.
mcpServer.title: mcpServer

rawTools.description: The raw tools list as fetched from upstream, sent by the gateway on create.
rawTools.title: rawTools

tools.description: The tools list as last fetched from upstream.
tools.title: tools

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: MCPToolSnapshot
